card.name: Family member words before a given name
card.fires_on: Family-relation words such as wife, sister, daughter, mum or married, right where a relative's first name is about to be given in news or biography text.

modes.label: Relation word before a name
modes.description: A word like wife, sister or daughter comes right before the relative's first name.
modes.example: Jerry and his<< wife>> Connie made their way south to the Great

modes.label: Marriage verb before a name
modes.description: The verb married comes right before the spouse's name in a short life story.
modes.example: In 1879 he<< married>> Mary Ann Luff, also an immigrant

modes.label: Comma after a relative
modes.description: A comma follows a relation word such as sister, before a name or a descriptive phrase.
modes.example: His spinster sister<<,>> Florence, often stayed with them.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward a woman's or relative's first name and away from titles and male names such as Mr, William or Charles.
card.plain: It spots a spot where a relative such as a wife or sister is about to be named.
